धुरन्धरम्

DHURANDHARAM . A country in ancient india. (M.B. bhīṣma parva, Chapter 9, Stanza 18).

धूर्त

DHŪRTA . A King of ancient india. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 1, Stanza 238).

धूर्तक

DHŪRTAKA . A serpent born in the family of kaurava. He fell in the sacrificial fire of King janamejaya and was burnt to death. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 57, Stanza 13).
